title: 双语信用情况说明书实时工作簿
instruction:
您是 Eamon Wainwright，支持 Meadowgate Housing Trust 全球信贷战略的财务分析师，Florian Mikkelsen 需要为产品审查会议准备好本季度的可重复使用的生产工作簿。 Ashcombe Provisions 通过魁北克分支机构分发该战略，并希望季度情况说明书和评论看起来像其自己的出版物，英文和法文页面相互镜像。使用提供的文件`ashcombe_last_quarter_factsheet.xlsx`作为唯一的版本参考。在工作目录的顶层构建`ashcombe_quarterly_factsheet_workbook.xlsx`。这是一本用于准备当前季度的实时工作簿，而不是粘贴的模型：将所有当前季度的输入单元格、注释文本区域和计算结果显示保留为空，直到输入数字和批准的措辞，但在提供输入时使计算和审查可供性发挥作用。保留已建立的展览顺序和标签的参考，保留固定的双语网格，并允许归属表接受九个扇区行，即使以前的版本显示了六个。将英语和法语版本放在具有匹配页面结构的单独可打印纸张上，并使每个法语数字与英语对应的相同潜在值相关联。
该工作簿应该能够轻松识别缺失的输入、超出范围的百分比以及两种语言页面之间的分歧，而无需依赖审阅者通过肉眼比较单元格。包括一份简短的用户指南，解释预期的进入领域、您为扩大行业覆盖范围而选择的处理方式以及发布前的审查检查。行业选择者必须使用参考工作簿中提供的精确受控选择，并且工作簿必须保留参考术语，而不是发明新的产品标签。在可以导出值的地方使用公式，保留可编辑输入和计算单元之间的明显区别，并且不要发明绩效数据、持有量、日期、批准、徽标或评论。它将打印用于分支机构分发，因此将英语和法语表设置为匹配的单页宽页面，具有可读的双语副本并且没有剪裁的表格边界。不要添加额外的可交付成果或重命名文件。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/ashcombe_last_quarter_factsheet.xlsx` — 唯一版本参考：它提供了先前资料单的展览顺序、标签、双语术语、六部门属性结构、受控部门词汇、重复出现的免责声明语言以及要保守地沿用的印刷惯例。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `ashcombe_quarterly_factsheet_workbook.xlsx` — 一本空白但实时的双语季度情况说明书制作工作簿，其中包含指南、共享输入以及匹配的英语和法语可打印表。 （完全使用此文件名将文件写入解算器起始工作目录的顶层。；工作簿必须包含按顺序命名为“指南”、“输入”、“英语”和“法语”的工作表。；当前季度的输入和叙述字段必须保留为空；可以填充公式、验证、条件格式、标签和审阅说明。；英语和法语页面必须使用相同的基础输入值和等效的展示结构。；没有外部链接、宏、发明的图形、发明的评论、徽标、或其他文件。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

sheets.name: Guide
rows: Ashcombe Provisions | Quarterly factsheet production guide
Prepare the current-quarter bilingual factsheet for branch print distribution. Complete Inputs first; English and Français are printable output pages.
Enter the quarter-end date, fund name, returns and sector figures only in the yellow cells on Inputs. Green cells are formulas or linked displays and should not be overwritten.
Use the dropdown in each Sector row. It contains only the controlled choices carried from the previous edition; do not type a new classification.

The prior edition displayed six sectors. This production grid reserves nine rows. Use only supplied current-quarter sectors from the controlled list; leave unsupported or unused rows blank and do not infer classifications.
Red warnings identify missing required entries, weights outside 0%–100%, and completed portfolio or benchmark weights that do not total 100%. Resolve them before release.
Write approved English and French commentary in the bordered yellow areas on their respective pages. Do not state a figure or conclusion that is not supported by the entered data and approved review.

□ Required inputs complete  □ Portfolio and benchmark totals reviewed  □ English/French numeric agreement confirmed  □ Commentary supported and approved  □ Print preview confirms both pages fit and table borders are visible
Both language pages link to the same Inputs values. If a display looks different, use the review warning and check the shared input rather than editing either page.

criteria.description: 交付成果是一本可读的 XLSX 工作簿，其中包含所需的四张纸。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表名称和文件可读性。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 openpyxl 打开并验证工作表名称为 Guide、Inputs、English 和 Français。

original.criterion: The deliverable is a readable XLSX workbook containing exactly the required four sheets.
original.evidence: Workbook sheet names and file readability.
original.grader_hint: Open with openpyxl and verify the sheet names are Guide, Inputs, English, and Français.

criteria.description: 这些表格按所需的“指南”、“输入”、“英语”、“法语”顺序显示。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表索引顺序。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作簿.工作表名称。

original.criterion: The sheets appear in the required Guide, Inputs, English, Français order.
original.grader_hint: Inspect workbook.sheetnames.

criteria.description: 输入表包含一个九行扇区表，其中包含必需的六个字段。
criteria.evidence: 标题行和九个连续的扇区条目行。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查行业、投资组合权重、基准权重、投资组合贡献、基准贡献和主动贡献，然后是九个可用行。

original.criterion: The Inputs sheet contains a nine-row sector table with the required six fields.
original.evidence: Header row and nine consecutive sector-entry rows.
original.grader_hint: Check for Sector, Portfolio Weight, Benchmark Weight, Portfolio Contribution, Benchmark Contribution, and Active Contribution, followed by exactly nine usable rows.

criteria.description: 每个扇区输入单元都具有数据验证，其选择与所提供的参考中的受控扇区词汇完全匹配。
criteria.evidence: 九个扇区单元的数据验证定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 提取验证公式/列表并将其值与参考工作簿的受控扇区列表进行比较。

original.criterion: Every sector-entry cell has data validation whose choices exactly match the controlled sector vocabulary from the supplied reference.
original.evidence: Data validation definitions on the nine sector cells.
original.grader_hint: Extract the validation formula/list and compare its values with the reference workbook's controlled sector list.

criteria.description: 活动贡献单元格是公式而不是粘贴的常量，并且源自同一行中的投资组合和基准贡献单元格。
criteria.evidence: 所有九个主动贡献单元格中的公式文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式并验证该行投资组合和基准贡献输入的每个引用。

original.criterion: The active contribution cells are formulas rather than pasted constants and derive from the portfolio and benchmark contribution cells in the same row.
original.evidence: Formula text in all nine active-contribution cells.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas and verify each references that row's portfolio and benchmark contribution inputs.

criteria.description: 扇区总计行是公式驱动的，聚合所有九个扇区行，不会遗漏或重复计算行。
criteria.evidence: 每个总计列中的公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查总公式是否准确覆盖九个扇区行并且不是常量。

original.criterion: The sector total row is formula-driven and aggregates all nine sector rows without omitting or double-counting a row.
original.grader_hint: Check that total formulas cover exactly the nine sector rows and are not constants.

criteria.description: 总体投资组合回报、基准回报及其比较与共享输入值或公式相关联。
criteria.evidence: 语言表上的公式关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证标题数字不是独立类型的常量。

original.criterion: Headline portfolio return, benchmark return, and their comparison are linked to shared Inputs values or formulas.
original.evidence: Formula relationships on the language sheets.
original.grader_hint: Verify that headline figures are not independently typed constants.

criteria.description: 显示的有效贡献总数等于填充输入时九个行级有效贡献的总和。
criteria.evidence: 公式依赖图。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用临时测试数据集评估公式并将总计与九行总和进行比较。

original.criterion: The displayed active contribution total equals the sum of the nine row-level active contributions when inputs are populated.
original.grader_hint: Evaluate formulas with a temporary test dataset and compare the total to the nine-row sum.

criteria.description: 英语和法语扇区表具有相同的扇区行数、列数、总行位置和展示顺序。
criteria.evidence: 工作表单元格几何形状和标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较两个工作表的边界框和表格行/列结构。

original.criterion: The English and French sector tables have the same number of sector rows, columns, total-row position, and exhibit order.
original.grader_hint: Compare the bounding boxes and table row/column structure of both sheets.

criteria.description: 法语工作表上的数字显示引用共享输入值或等效的英语源单元格，而不是单独的常量。
criteria.evidence: 法语表公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有数字表和标题显示单元格中的公式链接。

original.criterion: Numeric displays on the French sheet reference the shared Inputs values or equivalent English source cells rather than separate constants.
original.grader_hint: Inspect all numeric table and headline display cells for formula links.

criteria.description: 英语和法语的总行数由公式驱动，并引用相应的九行表。
criteria.evidence: 两种语言表上的总行公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 确保两种语言总计都不是硬编码值，并且每种语言总计都涵盖九行。

original.criterion: The English and French total rows are formula-driven and reference the corresponding nine-row tables.
original.evidence: Total-row formulas on both language sheets.
original.grader_hint: Ensure neither language total is a hard-coded value and each covers nine rows.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含共享扇区表的定义名称和关键标题输入。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿定义名称集合。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证名称解析为预期的输入范围并且可在公式中使用。

original.criterion: The workbook contains defined names for the shared sector table and key headline inputs.
original.grader_hint: Verify names resolve to the intended Inputs ranges and are usable in formulas.

criteria.description: 百分比和贡献单元格在输入、英语和法语中一致使用适当的百分比数字格式。
criteria.evidence: 单元格number_format值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查权重、回报和贡献的百分比格式，而不是常规或文本格式。

original.criterion: Percentage and contribution cells use appropriate percentage number formats consistently across Inputs, English, and Français.
original.grader_hint: Check weights, returns, and contributions for percentage formatting rather than General or text formats.

criteria.description: 通过一致的图例和格式约定，输入单元格在视觉上可与公式单元格区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 指导图例和单元格样式。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认指南解释了区别，并且可编辑和计算的范围使用不同的填充或保护状态。

original.criterion: Input cells are visually distinguishable from formula cells through a consistent legend and formatting convention.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the guide explains the distinction and that editable and calculated ranges use different fills or protection states.

criteria.description: 条件格式标记缺少必需的输入。
criteria.evidence: 所需输入范围的条件格式规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查规则并使用空白和已填充的单元格对其进行测试。

original.criterion: Conditional formatting flags missing required inputs.
original.evidence: Conditional-formatting rules on required input ranges.
original.grader_hint: Inspect rules and test them with blank and populated cells.

criteria.description: 条件格式会标记无效的重量总计或超出范围的百分比输入。
criteria.evidence: 条件格式规则和范围限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试零、负、超过100%和非100%总数的场景。

original.criterion: Conditional formatting flags invalid weight totals or out-of-range percentage inputs.
original.grader_hint: Test zero, negative, over-100%, and non-100%-total scenarios.

criteria.description: 输入表具有冻结窗格，可在输入扇区行时保持相关标题可见。
criteria.evidence: 工作表 freeze_panes 属性。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证输入标题下方和任何持久行标签右侧的冻结点。

original.criterion: The Inputs sheet has frozen panes that keep the relevant headers visible while entering sector rows.
original.grader_hint: Verify a freeze point below the input header and to the right of any persistent row labels.

criteria.description: 该指南解释了六至九个部门的扩张，并记录了对上一版本中未提及的部门的保守处理。
criteria.evidence: 指导散文。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的有界政策，例如仅使用当前季度提供的部门，将不受支持的行留空，并且不发明分类。

original.criterion: The Guide explains the six-to-nine-sector expansion and records a conservative treatment for sectors not represented in the prior edition.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit bounded policy such as using only supplied current-quarter sectors, leaving unsupported rows blank, and not inventing classifications.

criteria.description: 该指南确定了哪些单元格是可编辑的、哪些单元格是可计算的，以及如何使用下拉菜单和审查警告。
criteria.evidence: 指南说明和图例。
criteria.grader_hint: 新分析师应该能够在不打开公式单元格的情况下找到输入区域。

original.criterion: The Guide identifies which cells are editable, which are calculated, and how the dropdown and review warnings should be used.
original.grader_hint: A new analyst should be able to locate entry areas without opening formula cells.

criteria.description: 该指南包括一个预发布清单，涵盖完整性、总数、双语数字协议、评论支持和打印预览。
criteria.evidence: 清单文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认所有五个评论主题都存在。

original.criterion: The Guide includes a pre-release checklist covering completeness, totals, bilingual numeric agreement, commentary support, and print preview.
original.grader_hint: Confirm all five review topics are present.

criteria.description: 当前季度的所有手动输入单元在交付时均为空白。
criteria.evidence: 日期、回报、部门、权重、贡献、批准和叙述条目范围中的值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查指定的条目范围是否缺少文本、数字和示例值。

original.criterion: All current-quarter manual input cells are blank at delivery.
original.evidence: Values in date, return, sector, weight, contribution, approval, and narrative-entry ranges.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the designated entry ranges for absence of text, numbers, and example values.

criteria.description: 两种语言表上的注释文本区域都是空白的，但显然是保留供输入的。
criteria.evidence: 空白合并或边界叙述区域及其标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证不存在示例散文，并且这些区域有明确的边界且可写。

original.criterion: Commentary text areas on both language sheets are blank but visibly reserved for entry.
original.evidence: Blank merged or bordered narrative regions and their labels.
original.grader_hint: Verify no sample prose is present and that the areas are clearly bounded and writable.

criteria.description: 当所需的输入为空白时，公式驱动的显示单元格返回空白显示而不是零或错误。
criteria.evidence: 公式文本和重新计算的测试输出。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用临时空白输入副本并检查缓存或计算结果是否为空字符串且没有错误。

original.criterion: Formula-driven display cells return a blank display rather than zero or an error when the required Inputs are blank.
original.evidence: Formula text and recalculated test output.
original.grader_hint: Use a temporary blank-input copy and inspect cached or calculated results for empty strings and no errors.

criteria.description: 英文表使用参考版的展览标签和反复出现的免责声明术语，而没有引入不受支持的产品标签。
criteria.evidence: 与提供的参考相比可见标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较标签字符串和免责声明措辞；仅允许必要的双语或九行改编。

original.criterion: The English sheet uses the reference edition's exhibit labels and recurring disclaimer terminology, without introducing unsupported product labels.
original.evidence: Visible labels compared with the supplied reference.
original.grader_hint: Compare label strings and disclaimer wording; allow only necessary bilingual or nine-row adaptations.

criteria.description: 法语表使用相应的参考术语并反映英语展览顺序。
criteria.evidence: 法国标签和展位。
criteria.grader_hint: 将法语标签与参考进行比较，并将展览顺序与英语进行比较。

original.criterion: The French sheet uses the corresponding reference terminology and mirrors the English exhibit sequence.
original.grader_hint: Compare French labels with the reference and compare exhibit order with English.

criteria.description: 英文纸张打印精确为一页宽和一页高。
criteria.evidence: 打印区域、适合页面设置和渲染的 PDF。
criteria.grader_hint: 离线渲染并确认一页没有剪裁右边界。

original.criterion: The English sheet prints to exactly one page wide and one page tall.
original.evidence: Print area, fit-to-page settings, and rendered PDF.
original.grader_hint: Render offline and confirm one page with no clipped right boundary.

criteria.description: 法语纸张使用与英语相同的纸张尺寸和方向打印为一页宽和一页高。
criteria.evidence: 页面设置和渲染的 PDF。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较页面设置属性并计算两张图纸的渲染页面数。

original.criterion: The French sheet prints to exactly one page wide and one page tall using the same paper size and orientation as English.
original.grader_hint: Compare page setup properties and count rendered pages for both sheets.

criteria.description: 英语和法语打印区域具有匹配的边界尺寸，并且归属表的最右列和总行边框可见。
criteria.evidence: 打印区域范围和渲染的页面几何形状。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较使用的打印区域尺寸并检查渲染边缘是否有剪裁。

original.criterion: The English and French print areas have matching bounding dimensions and the attribution table's rightmost column and total-row border are visible.
original.evidence: Print-area ranges and rendered page geometry.
original.grader_hint: Compare used print-area dimensions and inspect the rendered edges for clipping.

criteria.description: 两种语言表都包含一个可见的九行归因表，后面紧跟着一个不同的总行。
criteria.evidence: 单元格边框、标签和表格几何形状。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证九个扇区行和一个单独格式化的总边界行。

original.criterion: Both language sheets contain a visible nine-row attribution table followed immediately by a distinct total row.
original.evidence: Cell borders, labels, and table geometry.
original.grader_hint: Verify nine sector rows and a separately formatted total boundary row.

criteria.description: 使用临时填充的测试数据集，每个显示的英语数字等于工作簿显示精度内相应的法语数字。
criteria.evidence: 跨表公式评估。
criteria.grader_hint: 用不同的正值、负值、零值和小数值填充输入，重新计算并比较配对显示。

original.criterion: With a temporary populated test dataset, every displayed English number equals the corresponding French number within the workbook's displayed precision.
original.grader_hint: Populate Inputs with varied positive, negative, zero, and decimal values, recalculate, and compare paired displays.

criteria.description: 不存在外部链接、宏或不受支持的嵌入对象。
criteria.evidence: 作业簿包装检查。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 XLSX 关系和内容类型的外部链接、VBA 或嵌入媒体。

original.criterion: No external links, macros, or unsupported embedded objects are present.
original.grader_hint: Inspect XLSX relationships and content types for external links, VBA, or embedded media.

criteria.description: 财务同事无需培训即可使用工作簿输入季度，了解哪些单元受到控制，解决扩展部门的歧义，检查双语一致性，并准备分支可打印的结果。
criteria.evidence: 指南清晰度、视觉层次结构、空白状态可用性以及渲染的英语/法语页面。
criteria.grader_hint: 将完整的工作簿视为实用的可重复使用的生产工具，而不仅仅是技术上有效的电子表格。

original.criterion: A finance colleague can use the workbook without training to enter a quarter, understand which cells are controlled, resolve the expanded-sector ambiguity, review bilingual consistency, and prepare a branch-printable result.
original.evidence: Guide clarity, visual hierarchy, blank-state usability, and rendered English/French pages.
original.grader_hint: Judge the complete workbook as a practical reusable production instrument, not merely as a technically valid spreadsheet.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

author_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A domain-oriented reviewer verifies the reporting logic and conservative sector treatment; an independent spreadsheet reviewer verifies formulas, validation, blank-state behavior, defined names, conditional formatting, and print rendering.

spec.professional_context: This is a quarterly reporting workbook for a credit strategy distributed through Ashcombe Provisions, with Meadowgate Housing Trust responsible for producing a branch-ready bilingual factsheet for internal product and distribution stakeholders. The work combines portfolio attribution, controlled commentary drafting, and print-oriented bilingual production.
difficulty_sources: The supplied edition uses a six-sector attribution grid while the reusable quarter-end instrument must accommodate nine sectors.
French copy is expected to run longer than the corresponding English copy, creating a practical trade-off between bilingual alignment and readable presentation.
The workbook must preserve numerical lineage and reusable calculation logic rather than merely displaying pasted answers.
The source edition does not fully specify how to handle the expanded sector set, so the analyst must make and document a conservative bounded judgment.

source_construction.content: Create one realistic prior-quarter edition workbook containing the established exhibit order, English and French labels, six populated sector rows, the controlled sector list, recurring disclaimer text, and print conventions. Use synthetic but internally consistent values and names. The six displayed sectors must be a subset of the controlled list; the new workbook will reserve nine rows without requiring the solver to invent sector names.

original_instruction:
You are Eamon Wainwright, the financial analyst supporting Meadowgate Housing Trust's global credit strategy, and Florian Mikkelsen needs this quarter's reusable production workbook ready for the product review meeting. Ashcombe Provisions distributes the strategy through Québec branches and expects the quarterly factsheet and commentary to look like its own established publication, with English and French pages mirroring one another. Use the supplied file `ashcombe_last_quarter_factsheet.xlsx` as the only edition reference. Build `ashcombe_quarterly_factsheet_workbook.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory. This is a live workbook for preparing the current quarter, not a pasted mock-up: leave all current-quarter input cells, commentary text areas, and calculated result displays empty until figures and approved wording are entered, but make the calculation and review affordances work when the inputs are supplied. Keep the established exhibit order and labels from the reference, retain the fixed bilingual grid, and allow the attribution table to accept nine sector rows even though the previous edition showed six. Put the English and French versions on separate printable sheets with matching page structure, and keep every French figure linked to the same underlying value as its English counterpart. The workbook should make it easy to identify missing inputs, out-of-range percentages, and disagreements between the two language pages without relying on a reviewer to compare cells by eye. Include a short user guide explaining the intended entry areas, the treatment you chose for the expanded sector coverage, and the review checks before release. The sector selector must use the exact controlled choices supplied in the reference workbook, and the workbook must retain the reference terminology rather than inventing new product labels. Use formulas wherever a value can be derived, preserve a visible distinction between editable inputs and calculated cells, and do not invent performance figures, holdings, dates, approvals, logos, or commentary. It will be printed for branch distribution, so set the English and French sheets up to print as matching one-page-wide pages with readable bilingual copy and no clipped table boundary. Do not add extra deliverables or rename the file.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/ashcombe_last_quarter_factsheet.xlsx` — The sole edition reference: it supplies the prior factsheet's exhibit order, labels, bilingual terminology, six-sector attribution structure, controlled sector vocabulary, recurring disclaimer language, and print conventions to be carried forward conservatively.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `ashcombe_quarterly_factsheet_workbook.xlsx` — A blank-but-live bilingual quarterly factsheet production workbook containing a guide, shared inputs, and matching English and French printable sheets. (Write the file at the top level of the solver's starting working directory using exactly this filename.; The workbook must contain sheets named Guide, Inputs, English, and Français, in that order.; Current-quarter inputs and narrative fields must remain blank; formulas, validations, conditional formatting, labels, and review instructions may be populated.; English and French pages must use the same underlying input values and equivalent exhibit structure.; No external links, macros, invented figures, invented commentary, logos, or additional files.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
